summary: Task 10 closes RB4-01, RA5-02, RA5-03, RC5-1, RC5-2, and RC5-4. One shared worklist walker checks every decoded JSON layer, root array, scalar array element, object key, and object value before either provider writes evidence. The dead decodedReviewFindings export is removed. Kimi checks before parseModelReview and its comment states that the check reads the raw answer. The independent gate passed 125 tests and the single focused rerun passed 98 tests. No blocking defect remains. Two disclosed mutation test gaps are nonblocking.
nonblocking_findings: RA6-01 (low, test gap): Mutation 9 re-extracts nested objects from the raw text and from every string. The run exited 0 and T111 passed. Re-extraction is a performance-only change. It is a superset scan, so no credential can be missed. Its cost on the 65,536-byte fixture is 877 ms, under the 2000 ms bound. The real quadratic driver is the per-string rule rebuild, which mutation 10 fails with rule scan ms: 8330. T111 does not isolate re-extraction, but no correctness or security defect results.

RA6-02 (low, test gap): Mutation 17 catches every walker error and refuses every answer. The run exited 0 and T112 passed. The worklist walker raises no error on safe answers, so a catch cannot fire and cannot refuse anything. The mutation premise contradicts T110, which requires a deep safe answer to be accepted without a throw. T110 and T111 already verify that the walker throws nothing on safe input. No correctness or security defect results.

RA6-03 (low): The MiniMax decoded-check comment at src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:3350 still labels the finding RB3-01 instead of RB4-01. The comment text states the behavior correctly and T114 validates only the Kimi comment. A stale-reference nit, not a behavior defect.

RA5-02 closure: no .ts file in src/, scripts/, or tests/ references decodedReviewFindings. Only measure documents and run logs name it. The function and its export are removed from src/storytime/book-pictures.ts. T113 passes.

RC5-1 closure: the worklist replaces call-stack recursion. A depth-4000 answer does not raise RangeError. T109 and T110 pass. RC5-2 closure: the credential rules are built once per call at lines 1161-1164. T115 passes with rule scan ms under 2000. RC5-4 closure: the dead export is removed.

Work bound: JSON trees are acyclic, so the walker terminates. A JSON string layer always shortens, so layer count is bounded by string length. The visited set dedups objects defensively. No quadratic or unbounded cost remains on hostile input. T111 (depth 400, 65,536 bytes) and T115 (1200 rules by 1200 keys) stay under 2 seconds.
